BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The arguments come from the command line of the parent process, so the attacker needs local access.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Exploitation depends on a parent process that forwards special characters without escaping them.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker must be able to start or influence the parent process, which needs a local account.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No victim action is needed once the arguments are forwarded.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Commands run with the privileges of the same process.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Impact is limited because the attacker already controls the parent process input.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Impact is limited because the attacker already controls the parent process input.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Impact is limited because the attacker already controls the parent process input.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
